source.title: First Try
source.body:
I hear you. You built this domain and hardware stack yourself on a tight budget, and now you need a lean, high-leverage system to source, productize, market, and ship without draining your capital. I’ll give you exact, free/low-cost workflows tailored to **Wix**, plus automation paths that won’t break the bank.

---
### 🔍 1. US Vendor Sourcing (Free & Vetting-Ready)
| Resource | Cost | How to Use It |
|----------|------|---------------|
| **Thomasnet** (thomsonnet.com) | Free directory access | Filter by state/industry. Export contact lists manually. Verify via public LLC registries. |
| **Alibaba** (alibaba.com) | Free search | Use “Trade Assurance” filter. Download business license photos from vendor profiles. Cross-check with DuckDuckGo Business. |
| **SBA Supplier Directory** (sba.gov) | Free | Find locally certified vendors, women/minority-owned suppliers, and grant-eligible wholesalers. |
| **Reddit & Industry Forums** (e.g., r/smallbusiness, niche-specific subs) | Free | Ask for vetted US manufacturers. DM verified sellers with sample requests. |
| **Amazon Business Supplier / Amazon Vendor Central** | Free to apply | If you sell physical goods, get approved to source wholesale at MSRP discounts. |

✅ **Vetting Checklist (Do this before spending):**
- Request a sample + invoice template
- Verify business license via state SOS or DDRC databases
- Check BBB & Trustpilot for shipping/quality complaints
- Confirm MOQs, lead times, and return policies in writing
- Use free tools like `duckduckgo.com/business` to verify domain/email legitimacy

---
### 💡 2. Product Ideation Framework (Based on Local Vendors)
1. **Trend Scan (Free):** 
   - Google Trends → filter by “US” + your niche
   - Ubersuggest Free Tier → 10 searches/month for keyword volume & competition
   - Amazon Best Sellers → sort by “Last 24 Hours” + read review gaps
2. **Margin Math:** 
   `Selling Price = (COGS × 3) + Shipping + Platform Fees + 20% Buffer`
   Target ≥70% gross margin to survive Wix/Stripe fees and low ad spend.
3. **Validation Loop:**
   - List product idea on a free landing page (Wix Pages or Carrd)
   - Run $0 organic traffic (Pinterest, Reddit, local Facebook groups)
   - Track clicks → email signups → cart adds before investing inventory

---
### 🖼️ 3. Product Image & Ad Enhancement (Zero-Cost Stack)
| Task | Free Tool | Workflow |
|---------------------|----------|
| Background removal / object cleanup | `remove.bg` (free tier: 5 images) | Clean product photos, isolate on white/brand color |
| Photo editing / resizing | `Photopea.com` (free Photoshop clone) | Batch adjust exposure, add watermarks, resize to Wix specs |
| Canva templates & social assets | `canva.com` (free account) | Create carousels, UGC-style ads, story templates |
| Stock/UGC images | Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay | Filter by “Commercial use” + niche keywords |
| Video editing for ads | CapCut (desktop/mobile) | 15-30s hooks: problem → product → CTA. Export optimized for TikTok/Reels |

✅ **Pro Tip:** Shoot one hero shot on your phone → edit in Photopea → create 3 ad variations in Canva → post organically first → only boost what gets engagement before scaling.

---
### 🌐 4. SEO Optimization (Wix-Native + Free External)
| Area | Action | Why It Matters |
|------|--------|----------------|
| **Wix SEO Wiz** | Enable in Settings > SEO | Auto-fixes meta tags, redirects, mobile usability |
| **Custom URLs & Sitemaps** | Settings > Site Structure → Customize URLs; Export XML sitemap | Crawlers love clean, logical paths |
| **Image Optimization** | Compress via TinyPNG (free) → add descriptive alt text | Speed + image search traffic |
| **Mobile Speed** | Remove unused Wix apps, defer JS, use WebP | Core Web Vitals impact rankings & bounce rate |
| **Keyword Research** | Ubersuggest Free Tier, AnswerThePublic (5 queries/day), Google Autocomplete | Target low-competition, high-intent long-tail keywords |
| **Content Engine** | Wix Blog (free) → publish 1x/week targeting vendor reviews, setup guides, comparison posts | Builds backlinks + positions you as authoritative |

✅ **Quick SEO Audit Checklist:**
- [ ] Title tags <60 chars, meta descriptions <155 chars
- [ ] H1 matches page intent, H2/H3 structure logical
- [ ] All images compressed & alt-text filled
- [ ] Mobile test passes (PageSpeed Insights free)
- [ ] Google Search Console connected + 404s checked weekly

---
### 📦 5. Shipping Partners Through Wix (Free/Low-Cost Path)
| Carrier | Cost/Setup | Best For |
|---------|------------|----------|
| **USPS + Postmark** | $0.65/package, free labels up to 5/day | Low volume, domestic orders |
| **LFO (USPS Lower Rates)** | Free account, lower base rates | Volume shipping within US |
| **EasyPost** | 7-day free trial → multi-carrier rate comparison | Testing USPS vs UPS/FedEx before committing |

✅ **Wix Setup Steps:**
1. Wix Admin → Settings > Shipping & Payment
2. Enable “Wix Payments” (if not already)
3. Add carrier: `USPS` or `UPS` → connect via API/webhook if needed
4. Enable “Rate Shopping” so customers see real-time costs at checkout
5. Set free shipping threshold only after calculating true COGS + fees

⚠️ Avoid paid Wix add-ons unless absolutely necessary. Stick to native shipping + USPS/LFO for bootstrap efficiency.

---
### ⚙️ 6. Automation Stack (Free Tiers That Actually Work)
| Tool | Free Tier Limits | Use Case with Wix |
|------|------------------|-------------------|
| **Zapier** | 100 tasks/mo, 2,500 actions/mo | Wix order → Google Sheets → Vendor email → Customer confirmation |
| **Make.com (Integromat)** | 300 actions/mo | Webhook from Wix checkout → Slack alert → Auto-reply via Twilio/SMS |
| **Wix Native Automations** | Unlimited basic flows | Email sequences, inventory alerts, abandoned cart reminders |
| **GitHub Actions** | Free for public repos | Run Python/Node scripts to scrape vendor prices or update product feeds |

✅ **Starter Automation Blueprint:**
```
Wix Checkout Event → Zapier → Create Google Sheet Row → Send Vendor Order (if print-on-demand) → Trigger Customer Email (Wix Native)
```
All free. Scales with your revenue.

---
### 🧭 Next Steps: Tell Me These 3 Things & I’ll Generate Exact Assets for You
1. **What product category/niche** are you selling? (e.g., tech accessories, handmade goods, digital templates, print-on-demand)
2. **Do you have a current vendor list or supplier type?** (wholesale, dropshipping, local artisans, custom manufacturing)
3. **Which automation flow feels most urgent right now?** (vendor outreach → product listing → ad creative → SEO content → shipping setup)

Reply with those 3 points and I’ll deliver:
- A ready-to-import vendor sourcing spreadsheet template
- Exact Wix settings + free tool workflow for your niche
- Step-by-step Zapier/Make automation blueprint
- SEO keyword list + blog post outline tailored to your products

You’ve already done the hardest part. Now let’s turn that hardware into profit with zero overhead.
